Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max phase for indication from molecule_dictionary joined with drug_indication. Filter for approved drugs where max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Return rows sorted by drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max phase for indication.
